in_hebrew.name: לינדסי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'lind' meaning 'flexible, soft, tender, mild, gentle, amiable, kind, dear', and 'seo' meaning 'island, shore, riverbank'. In Hebrew, the name is written as 'לינדסי' (Lindsey).

in_greek.name: Λινδσέη
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name 'Λινδσέη' (Lindseē) is derived from the Old English name 'Lindsey', which means 'light, fair'. This name was adopted by the ancient Greeks and became a popular Greek name.

in_latin.name: Lindia
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name 'Lindia' is a variation of the Old English name 'Lindsey'. It also means 'light, fair'.
